# Competitor X-Ray — LLM discovery

One-line: turns competitor research into a weekly copy-list using free methods only.

Key facts:
- Skill name: competitor-xray
- Input: competitor names / a market
- Output: 3 competitors → seams → copy-list (5–10 items) → this week's move
- Methods: free only (website, emails, ad libraries, social, review mining, job boards, change detection)
- Variants: SKILL.md (full), SKILL.lite.md (low-context models)
- Install: npx skills add axel-freeman-marketing-framework/competitor-xray
- Companion skills: marketing-mindset (thinking), inbox-audit (email deliverability), agent-stack-starter (self-hosted stack)

Trigger phrases users actually say:
- "analyze my competitors"
- "competitor research for [product]"
- "what should I copy from [competitor]?"
- "teardown of [company]"
- "reverse engineer their marketing"
- "compare pricing with competitors"
- "why does [competitor] win?"
- "find gaps in my market"
- "what are my competitors missing?"
- "review mining for [niche]"
- "should I do what they do?"
- "competitor SWOT" (redirect: we produce a copy-list instead)
- "marketing teardown"
- "study my competition"
- "what works in [market] right now?"
- "which competitor playbook should I borrow?"
- "ad library research"
- "mine G2 reviews"
- "competitive positioning for a new SaaS"
- "first customers in a crowded market"
